tasks.title: Retain worktrees after successful merge
tasks.description: Change the merge queue and manual merge API so successful merges update delivery state without removing the issue worktree. Merge success should still set `mergeState=merged`, emit completion events, and allow Done transition logic to run, but cleanup must be deferred until archive.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge queue success does not call WorktreeManager.remove
Manual POST /api/issues/:number/merge success does not call WorktreeManager.remove
After merge success, issue delivery state still reaches Done/Completed with mergeState=merged through the existing merge success flow
Worktree status remains available for a merged Done issue
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Rename cleanup-oriented merge logs to retention-oriented logs. Do not change merge conflict, rebase, or retry behavior.

tasks.title: Make archive own cleanup and reporting
tasks.description: Update archive service and API behavior so archive remains the explicit cleanup boundary for worktrees and checkpoints. Single archive should return visible warnings for false-Done or non-Done issues, batch archive should archive only truly merged Done issues, and batch responses should include archived/skipped/skippedNumbers plus a clear message.
acceptanceCriteria: Single issue archive defaults to cleaning the retained worktree and checkpoints
Single issue archive with cleanup=false marks the issue archived without removing worktree or checkpoints
Single issue archive of done-but-not-merged returns a visible warning while allowing the archive
archiveAllCompleted archives only issues classified as merged and skips done-not-merged issues
archiveAllCompleted response includes archived, skipped, skippedNumbers, and message
Default issue list/kanban API results exclude archived issues, while archived=true returns archived issues
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer extending archiveAllCompleted(projectId, { cleanup }) and POST /issues/archive-completed body parsing so --no-cleanup has the same meaning for single and batch archive.

tasks.title: Update CLI archive semantics
tasks.description: Update `mo issue archive` so single and batch archive output reflects backend warnings, skipped false-Done issues, and cleanup semantics. The CLI should pass cleanup consistently, print server-provided batch messages, and avoid duplicating warning prefixes.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue archive <number> prints a single warning prefix and never prints Warning: Warning:
mo issue archive <number> --no-cleanup sends cleanup=false and reports successful archive
mo issue archive --all-completed prints archived and skipped counts from the API response
mo issue archive --all-completed reports skipped issue numbers for done-but-not-merged issues
If batch --no-cleanup is supported, it sends cleanup=false; if not supported, the CLI shows a clear error instead of silently ignoring the flag
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The CLI is a thin client; keep archive trust decisions in the API/service and only format returned data.

tasks.title: Update Web archive and Done worktree UX
tasks.description: Update Web archive interactions so backend warnings/errors and batch skipped results are visible, the Done column shows batch archive whenever Done issues exist, and Done worktrees are described as retained for review/traceability. The Archived page should remain history-only by removing restore/unarchive affordances while keeping search and issue-detail navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Single issue archive in Web UI displays backend warning or error feedback instead of silently invalidating queries
Batch archive in the Done column displays archived count, skipped count, skippedNumbers, and explanatory message
Done column batch archive button is visible when Done has issues even if archivedCount is zero
Done issue worktree UI states the worktree is retained for review/traceability and archive will remove it
Archived page lists and searches archived issues and links to issue detail
Archived page does not show restore, unarchive, or checkpoint/worktree restoration actions
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts, packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, packages/cli/web/src/components/StageColumn.tsx, IssueCard.tsx, IssueDetailPage.tsx, WorktreePanel.tsx, ArchivedPage.tsx, and Web UI tests
tasks.notes: Use existing toast/error patterns. Do not introduce a restore workflow or new archived issue execution path.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end archive regression coverage
tasks.description: Add focused regression tests that tie together merge retention, archive cleanup, API filtering, CLI output, and Web archive behavior. These tests should prove the lifecycle boundary: Done retains inspection state, Archive hides the issue and cleans retained local state.
acceptanceCriteria: Test proves merge queue success leaves the issue worktree present after Done/merged
Test proves manual merge API success leaves the issue worktree present
Test proves archiving removes retained worktree and checkpoints by default
Test proves archived issues are hidden from default issue list/kanban data and visible through archived list queries
Test proves batch archive skips done-but-not-merged issues and returns skippedNumbers
Test proves CLI warning output does not contain Warning: Warning:
Test proves Web Done column archive entry appears when Done has issues and archivedCount is zero
Test proves Archived page has no restore/unarchive action
npm test passes in packages/cli
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep tests deterministic and avoid requiring a real remote merge. Use existing mock WorktreeManager and web test patterns where available.
